children: Overview
U.S. regional bank's Q3 adjusted EPS missed analyst expectations
Company approved new $175 mln stock repurchase program
Quarter saw record loan production and strong loan growth
Q3 net income increased to $78.9 compared to last year
Outlook
Company expects to focus on growing customer relationships and hiring talent in coming quarters
Company sees mortgage banking income pressured by higher interest rates impacting loan production
Result Drivers
LOAN GROWTH - Co said results were driven by record loan production and strong net loan growth
MORTGAGE SLOWDOWN - Co said higher mortgage rates led to lower mortgage banking income and reduced new loan production
EXPENSE DISCIPLINE - Co attributed lower noninterest expense to reduced deferred compensation and higher deferred loan costs, partly offset by increased health insurance claims
